# RFP ACT SACT 26-24 – Resolicitation

Request for Proposal for **Minor Works Construction Framework**.

Period of Performance: 01 January 2027 to 31 December 2027, with four (4) option years.

Option Period 1: 01 January 2027 to 31 December 2028

Option Period 2: 01 January 2028 to 31 December 2029

Option Period 3: 01 January 2029 to 31 December 2030

Option Period 4: 01 January 2030 to 31 December 2031

**Site Survey:** In lieu of a bidder’s conference, HQ SACT invites bidders to a site survey that will be conducted on **07 October 2026** at HQ SACT, 7857 Blandy Rd, Suite 100, Norfolk, VA, 23551. Participation in the site survey is **NOT** mandatory to participate in the RFP and submit a proposal.

**Bid closing date:** Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, **no later than 26 October 2026, 0900 hours, Eastern Standard Time**, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-24 Resolicitation – Amendment #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026024_resolicitation_amdt1.pdf)

[**Questions & Answers #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026024_resolicitation_qa1.pdf)

[**Site Survey Questions & Answers**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026024_qa-survey.pdf)
